issue_body:
## /projects/screenshot-to-primevue performance regression

**Audit date:** 2026-11-16T18:30:09.520Z
**Page:** `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue`

### Scores
| Metric | Previous | Current | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Performance | 80 | 78 | **−2** (persistent, now 7 pts below threshold) |
| LCP | 4233 ms | 4622 ms | **+389 ms** (material increase) |
| TBT | 152.3 ms | 137.5 ms | −15 ms (slight improvement) |
| CLS | 0 | 0 | stable |

### Impact
Performance has been below 85 for at least two consecutive audits and LCP is now worsening. At 4.6 s LCP, this page is likely penalised in Core Web Vitals.

### Suggested fixes
1. Identify the LCP element (likely a sample screenshot thumbnail or the drop-zone image) and add `<link rel="preload">` for it.
2. Add `loading="lazy"` to the sample thumbnail images that are below the fold.
3. Confirm no large unoptimised images are being fetched eagerly on page load.
4. Consider serving thumbnails in WebP/AVIF at display resolution.

### Also noted (below 85, watching)
- `/projects/note-structurer` performance: 83 (second consecutive audit below 85, stable jitter — monitor next run)
